//: Source of the shared row classes of ontola/atomic-plugins#177 (option 4). `node ontology-kit/ontology.mjs build` turns this plus base.json into the published term files under ontology/ and the subject constants in terms.mjs. A reference in requires, recommends or classtype is either a term defined here (a property shortname, or a class name) or an absolute URL of an existing term that is reused, never copied. Published terms never change: a change of meaning gets a new shortname or class version (see ontology-kit/README.md). Every term is declared, not verified.

v1.name: Shared row classes v1
v1.description: Row classes that several atomic-plugins drive apps sync into, so a plugin's view works on any table of that class (ontola/atomic-plugins#177). Declared, not verified: no plugin writes these classes yet.

v2.name: Buildings v1
v2.description: Classes of the AtomicBuildings digital-twin app: a home, its spaces and elements, the sources the user gave, the AI runs and evidence behind each fact, the questions the AI asks and the listings agents publish. Declared, not verified: no app writes these classes yet.

event-v1.name: Event
event-v1.description: A calendar event. Placed by its first civil day and, for multi-day or all-day events, its exclusive end day; timed events also carry their exact start and end instants as RFC 3339 strings with offset. Provider data (ids, ETags, links, sync baselines) is not part of this class.

issue-v1.name: Issue
issue-v1.description: An issue or task, using the task/v1 vocabulary every AtomicServer embeds: status (todo, doing, blocked, done; done is closed), body, assignee and due date. Provider data (issue numbers, labels, comments, sync state) is not part of this class.

time-entry-v1.name: Time entry
time-entry-v1.description: One interval of work: a start instant, an end instant (absent while a timer runs), and optionally a project, a person and a billable flag. Provider data (source ids, observation logs) is not part of this class.

work-project-v1.name: Project
work-project-v1.description: A named body of work that time entries belong to.

work-person-v1.name: Person
work-person-v1.description: A person who performed work, by name. Not an Atomic authentication agent.

bank-transaction-v1.name: Bank transaction
bank-transaction-v1.description: A booked bank transaction: account, currency, an exact signed decimal amount and a value date, plus the bank's own narrative and reference and the person's own category and note. Import bookkeeping (source ids, fingerprints, statement numbers) is not part of this class.

building-home-v1.name: Home
building-home-v1.description: A property: the digital twin of one house or apartment (IfcProject). The permission anchor of everything in it. Declared, not verified.

building-site-v1.name: Site
building-site-v1.description: The plot a building stands on (IfcSite).

building-building-v1.name: Building
building-building-v1.description: One building on a site (IfcBuilding). Storeys are local to its origin, rotated by its rotation.

building-storey-v1.name: Storey
building-storey-v1.description: One floor of a building (IfcBuildingStorey). Coordinates of what is on it are local to the storey.

building-space-v1.name: Space
building-space-v1.description: A room or outdoor area (IfcSpace). Its boundary is stored, derived from walls, so rooms show before walls are confirmed. Origin and review properties record who proposed it.

building-element-v1.name: Element
building-element-v1.description: A building element (IfcWall, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, ...) in one class: the IFC class is a property, not a type. Origin and review properties record who proposed it.

building-source-v1.name: Source
building-source-v1.description: Something the user gave: a photo, video, PDF, floor plan, note or voice memo, as a File resource plus what is known about it.

building-analysis-run-v1.name: Analysis run
building-analysis-run-v1.description: One AI pass over sources: which model, what it read and how it ended. Its summary is the description. Resources it creates point back with created-by-run.

building-evidence-v1.name: Evidence
building-evidence-v1.description: A source and a place in it that supports a fact, so the app can show why the AI believes something and a person can reject it.

building-question-v1.name: Building question
building-question-v1.description: The extras of a question the AI asks the user. Meant to sit on the same resource as issue-v1, which holds name, status, body and assignee; this class does not repeat them.

building-listing-v1.name: Listing
building-listing-v1.description: What an agent publishes about a home (schema.org RealEstateListing). Separate from the twin: the public selection says which confirmed parts may be shown. Title is the name, the text is the description.

atomic-calendar-day.name: Day
atomic-calendar-day.description: First civil day of the event (YYYY-MM-DD), in the event's own time zone as the provider gives it. The shortname is the one AtomicServer's built-in Calendar view matches (calendarFields).

atomic-calendar-end-day.name: End day
atomic-calendar-end-day.description: Exclusive end day (YYYY-MM-DD) of a multi-day or all-day event: the first day it no longer covers. Absent means a single day.

atomic-calendar-all-day.name: All day
atomic-calendar-all-day.description: Whether the event lasts whole days. Absent means false.

atomic-calendar-start.name: Start
atomic-calendar-start.description: Exact start instant of a timed event, as an RFC 3339 date-time string with its UTC offset, exactly as the provider gave it. A string rather than a timestamp, so the offset is kept.

atomic-calendar-end.name: End
atomic-calendar-end.description: Exact exclusive end instant of a timed event, as an RFC 3339 date-time string with its UTC offset.

atomic-calendar-location.name: Location
atomic-calendar-location.description: Where the event takes place, as free text.

atomic-calendar-notes.name: Notes
atomic-calendar-notes.description: The event's description, as plain text.

atomic-calendar-recurrence.name: Recurrence
atomic-calendar-recurrence.description: Recurrence rule, in the JSON payload AtomicServer's calendar-recurrence reads (browser/lib/src/calendar-recurrence.ts).

work-start.name: Start
work-start.description: Start instant of a work interval, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

work-end.name: End
work-end.description: End instant of a completed work interval, milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Absent while a timer is running.

work-project.name: Project
work-project.description: Project this work interval belongs to.

work-billable.name: Billable
work-billable.description: Whether this work interval is marked billable. Does not imply invoicing or payment.

bank-account.name: Account
bank-account.description: Account identifier: an IBAN when the bank gives one, otherwise the bank's own account id.

bank-currency.name: Currency
bank-currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the amount.

bank-amount.name: Amount
bank-amount.description: Exact signed decimal string in the account currency, at most 5 fraction digits. Negative is money out; positive is money in.

bank-value-date.name: Value date
bank-value-date.description: Bank value date (YYYY-MM-DD), without an inferred time zone.

bank-description.name: Description
bank-description.description: The bank's original narrative for the transaction, verbatim.

bank-reference.name: Reference
bank-reference.description: Bank reference, or customer reference if the bank gives none.

money-category.name: Category
money-category.description: The person's own category for this transaction, as free text. Never written by an importer.

money-note.name: Note
money-note.description: The person's own note on this transaction. Never written by an importer.

bldg-units.name: Units
bldg-units.description: Length unit of the home. All stored lengths are metres; this is the display preference (for example metric or imperial).

bldg-north-angle.name: North angle
bldg-north-angle.description: Angle in degrees from the +Y axis to true north, counter-clockwise seen from above.

bldg-address.name: Address
bldg-address.description: Private street address of the property, as free text. Never published; a listing has its own public address.

bldg-cover-image.name: Cover image
bldg-cover-image.description: A File resource used as the cover image.

bldg-boundary.name: Boundary
bldg-boundary.description: Polygon outline as a JSON array of [x, y] points in metres, in the coordinates of the containing storey (or of the site for a Site). Not self-closing; the last point connects to the first.

bldg-home.name: Home
bldg-home.description: The Home this resource belongs to.

bldg-site.name: Site
bldg-site.description: The Site a Building stands on.

bldg-rotation.name: Rotation
bldg-rotation.description: Rotation of the building around the Z axis, in degrees, relative to the site coordinates.

bldg-geo-origin.name: Geo origin
bldg-geo-origin.description: Optional geographic anchor of the building origin, as JSON {"lat": number, "lon": number, "alt": number} (WGS 84, altitude in metres).

bldg-building.name: Building
bldg-building.description: The Building a Storey is part of. Spatial containment is a link, not the resource parent.

bldg-elevation.name: Elevation
bldg-elevation.description: Height of the storey floor above the building origin, in metres, Z up.

bldg-height.name: Height
bldg-height.description: Floor-to-ceiling or floor-to-floor height, in metres.

bldg-level.name: Level
bldg-level.description: Storey number: 0 is ground floor, negative is below ground.

bldg-storey.name: Storey
bldg-storey.description: The Storey this resource is on. Coordinates of its geometry are local to this storey. Spatial containment is a link, not the resource parent.

bldg-space.name: Space
bldg-space.description: The Space (room) this resource is in or was captured in.

bldg-usage.name: Usage
bldg-usage.description: What the space is used for. One of: living, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, hall, storage, technical, outdoor, other.

bldg-ifc-class.name: IFC class
bldg-ifc-class.description: The IFC entity this element maps to, so an IFC export is a mapping and not a redesign. Not an exhaustive IFC list. One of: IfcWall, IfcSlab, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcStair, IfcRoof, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCovering, IfcRailing, IfcFurnishingElement, IfcBuildingElementProxy.

bldg-ifc-guid.name: IFC GUID
bldg-ifc-guid.description: Optional 22-character IFC GlobalId, kept so a re-export stays stable.

bldg-hosted-by.name: Hosted by
bldg-hosted-by.description: The Element that hosts this one, for openings: the wall a door or window sits in.

bldg-geometry-kind.name: Geometry kind
bldg-geometry-kind.description: Which shape the geometry JSON holds. One of: wallAxis, extrusion, opening, mesh.

bldg-geometry.name: Geometry
bldg-geometry.description: The shape, as JSON whose layout depends on the geometry kind: wallAxis {start, end, height, thickness}; extrusion {polygon, depth}; opening {offset, width, height, sill}; mesh {file} linking a glTF/GLB. Metres, local to the storey. Checked by the app, not by the server.

bldg-material.name: Material
bldg-material.description: Primary material as free text. Not a materials catalogue.

bldg-attributes.name: Attributes
bldg-attributes.description: Type-specific fields (door swing, wall thickness, glazing) as a JSON object, validated per IFC class by a JSON Schema shipped next to the ontology.

bldg-origin.name: Origin
bldg-origin.description: Who produced the fact. One of: user, ai, import.

bldg-review-state.name: Review state
bldg-review-state.description: Whether a person has reviewed the fact. Only confirmed facts are published. One of: proposed, confirmed, rejected.

bldg-confidence.name: Confidence
bldg-confidence.description: Confidence of the producer, from 0 to 1.

bldg-uncertainty.name: Uncertainty
bldg-uncertainty.description: Uncertainty of a measured value, in metres. Listings must show areas as indicative when this is set by an AI.

bldg-created-by-run.name: Created by run
bldg-created-by-run.description: The AnalysisRun that produced this resource. Rejecting a run's proposals is one filtered bulk edit on this property.

bldg-source-file.name: File
bldg-source-file.description: The Atomic File resource holding the media of this source.

bldg-media-kind.name: Media kind
bldg-media-kind.description: What the media is. One of: photo, video, pdf, floorplan, note, voice.

bldg-captured-at.name: Captured at
bldg-captured-at.description: When the media was captured, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

bldg-scale.name: Scale
bldg-scale.description: A known size reference in the source that anchors real measurements, as JSON, for example {"kind": "scale", "ratio": 100} or {"kind": "length", "metres": 0.5, "locator": {...}}.

bldg-source-status.name: Source status
bldg-source-status.description: Processing state of the source. One of: new, processing, processed, failed.

bldg-derived-from.name: Derived from
bldg-derived-from.description: The sources this one was derived from, for example the video a frame was sampled from or the PDF a page came from.

bldg-model.name: Model
bldg-model.description: Name of the AI model that ran.

bldg-model-version.name: Model version
bldg-model-version.description: Exact version or snapshot of the model.

bldg-started-at.name: Started at
bldg-started-at.description: When the run started, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

bldg-run-status.name: Run status
bldg-run-status.description: State of the run. One of: running, completed, failed.

bldg-source.name: Source
bldg-source.description: The source this evidence comes from.

bldg-locator.name: Locator
bldg-locator.description: Where in the source the evidence is, as JSON: page, bounding box, time range or frame, whichever the media kind has.

bldg-supports.name: Supports
bldg-supports.description: The Element, Space or other resource this evidence supports.

bldg-property.name: Property
bldg-property.description: Optional: the property of the supported resource this evidence is for, when it supports one value and not the whole resource.

bldg-question-kind.name: Question kind
bldg-question-kind.description: What kind of answer is wanted. One of: confirm, choose, measure, upload, text.

bldg-about.name: About
bldg-about.description: The resource the question is about.

bldg-options.name: Options
bldg-options.description: For a choose question, the offered choices as a JSON array of strings.

bldg-wants.name: Wants
bldg-wants.description: For an upload or measure question, the media kind wanted. One of: photo, video, pdf, floorplan, note, voice.

bldg-why.name: Why
bldg-why.description: What answering unlocks, as text shown to the person.

bldg-answer.name: Answer
bldg-answer.description: The answer as text: a value, a choice or free text.

bldg-answer-sources.name: Answer sources
bldg-answer-sources.description: Sources the person added to answer, such as a photo with a tape measure in frame.

bldg-listing-status.name: Listing status
bldg-listing-status.description: Publication state of the listing. One of: draft, published, sold.

bldg-asking-price.name: Asking price
bldg-asking-price.description: Asking price in the listing currency.

bldg-currency.name: Currency
bldg-currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the asking price.

bldg-public-address.name: Public address
bldg-public-address.description: Address shown publicly, which may be less exact than the private home address.

bldg-published-at.name: Published at
bldg-published-at.description: When the listing was published, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

bldg-public-selection.name: Public selection
bldg-public-selection.description: Which Elements, Sources and storeys may be shown, as JSON {"elements": [...], "sources": [...], "storeys": [...]} of subjects. Unreviewed (proposed) facts are never published.
